summary: Thin round magnetic encoder disc with a central round bore. Two small circular flat marks are visible on one face.

mountingSurfaces.description: Bottom flat face, centered on the bore, which would seat against a shaft shoulder or hub.
Top flat face, centered on the bore. Two small circular marks are visible on it, off-center and near the rim.

notes: The dimensions come from the supplied listing (OD 9.7 mm, ID 2.0 mm, 2 mm thick), which is marked unverified. The image proportions match them: the bore is about 0.2 of the diameter and the thickness is about a fifth of it. The through-bore is assumed from the visible light at the bottom of the hole. The two circular marks on the face are not dimensioned, so I did not model them or give their positions or sizes. The bore appears to run along the disc's flat-face normal (z axis).
